discovery.assignment: target cell CELLS[seed%4], one first qualifying position per seed
discovery.criteria: same side/from-X, two distinct non-double X connectors, both destinations opened, focal hand 4 or 5, empty stock

comparison: keep HIGH minus keep LOW (force spend LOW minus force spend HIGH), paired hidden worlds
limitations: assumed locked/open branch semantics; min-pips discovery; observational opponent strata; normal 95% position CI exploratory and uncorrected; block winner unassigned; pairwise not global regret
